tools.name: reserve_stock
tools.description: Hold units of a warehouse item for an order.
queries: Put five blue units aside for the customer.
Can you make sure those pieces aren't allocated to someone else?

tools.name: release_reservation
tools.description: Return held inventory to available stock.
queries: The order fell through so free its reserved units.
Undo the hold against those ten items.

tools.name: count_stock
tools.description: Read current physical on-hand inventory for an item.
queries: How many of these are actually in the building?
Give me the latest shelf count for this SKU.

tools.name: adjust_stock
tools.description: Correct the recorded inventory after a physical count.
queries: The shelf count was off by three, fix the inventory record.
Book the discrepancy against the inventory balance.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Find time windows with no scheduling conflicts.
queries: Which times are open Thursday for both speakers?
Find me half an hour when neither of us is booked.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Add an appointment to the calendar.
queries: Book the quarterly review for 10 on Wednesday.
Put me down for a call with Mina on Friday.

tools.name: move_booking
tools.description: Change the date or time of an existing appointment.
queries: Push tomorrow's standup back an hour.
Move our existing call to after lunch.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Remove an existing appointment.
queries: Scratch today's one-on-one.
Take the consultation off my calendar.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Convert written content into a requested language.
queries: I need this paragraph in Korean.
Put these instructions into plain Italian.

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Identify which language a passage is written in.
queries: Can you tell what language the label uses?
Is this written in Slovak or Czech?

tools.name: transliterate
tools.description: Rewrite text in another script while retaining pronunciation.
queries: Spell this name with Latin letters the way it sounds.
Convert the Cyrillic spelling into Roman characters.

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: Give the meaning and usage of a dictionary entry.
queries: What does this word mean in this sentence?
Show the dictionary sense of that expression.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Fetch the stored invoice record and its line items.
queries: Pull up the bill from last month with all the charges.
Find the original invoice for the second delivery.

tools.name: create_credit
tools.description: Issue a credit against a customer's invoice balance.
queries: Take the duplicate charge off their balance.
Apply a credit for the defective unit on this bill.

tools.name: reconcile_payment
tools.description: Match a received payment to the correct invoice.
queries: That incoming wire is for the August bill, link them.
The money arrived yesterday but the invoice still looks unpaid.

tools.name: send_reminder
tools.description: Notify a customer about an unpaid bill.
queries: Remind them payment is overdue.
Ask the customer to pay the outstanding invoice.

tools.name: find_document
tools.description: Search document titles and text for matching files.
queries: Find the notes where we discussed remote onboarding.
I don't remember the filename, only the phrase delayed approval.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Show textual differences between revisions of a document.
queries: What changed between today's draft and Monday's?
Line up the two versions and show their edits.

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Make a prior saved revision the current document.
queries: Roll the policy document back to yesterday's copy.
Undo the last version update by restoring the earlier file.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: Show the revision history and timestamps of a file.
queries: When was this memo edited?
List all saved drafts of this particular file.

tools.name: trim_audio
tools.description: Cut an audio recording to a selected time range.
queries: Keep only the first thirty seconds of the clip.
I just need the segment between 1:15 and 2:00.

tools.name: normalize_audio
tools.description: Adjust loudness of a recording to a target level.
queries: Bring this interview up to the standard playback volume.
Make the spoken sections about as loud as our other episodes.

tools.name: extract_audio
tools.description: Save the soundtrack from a video as an audio file.
queries: I only want the sound from this MP4.
Can you pull out the voice track without the pictures?

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Convert spoken words in a recording to written text.
queries: Write out what the guests say in this recording.
I need a transcript of the raw interview.

tools.name: print_label
tools.description: Render a ready-to-print address label for a parcel.
queries: Make a label I can stick on this box.
Generate the printable label for the recipient address.

tools.name: validate_address
tools.description: Check whether a shipping address is complete and deliverable.
queries: Will this address actually work for a delivery?
Check whether the postcode matches the destination.

tools.name: estimate_postage
tools.description: Calculate shipping charges for a specified parcel.
queries: How much to send this two-kilo box?
Price out delivery to the customer before I confirm.

tools.name: track_delivery
tools.description: Fetch carrier scans and the current delivery status.
queries: Where did the carrier last see this parcel?
Has the shipment made it to the recipient yet?

tools.name: register_attendee
tools.description: Add a named attendee to a workshop roster.
queries: Sign Leo up for the Saturday class.
Please give this person a place in the workshop.

tools.name: mark_attendance
tools.description: Record that a registered attendee arrived at a workshop.
queries: Ren is here, check them in.
Mark the participant present for today's session.

tools.name: waitlist_attendee
tools.description: Queue an attendee for a place when a workshop is full.
queries: Add my name in case a space opens up.
The seminar is sold out, can I join the queue?

tools.name: withdraw_attendee
tools.description: Remove a participant from a workshop roster and free the seat.
queries: Jo can't come anymore, give the place back.
Drop the attendee from the workshop list.

tools.name: log_watering
tools.description: Record when a plant was watered.
queries: I watered all the east window pots just now.
Add today's watering to the herb log.

tools.name: next_watering
tools.description: Estimate when a plant needs to be watered again.
queries: When should I water the rubber plant next?
Which pots are due for water?

tools.name: log_repotting
tools.description: Record that a plant was moved to a new pot.
queries: Save the date I transferred the lemon tree.
Update the history now that the fern is in a bigger container.

tools.name: measure_growth
tools.description: Compare recorded plant heights over time.
queries: How much taller are the seedlings this week?
Chart how the tomato heights have changed.

tools.name: borrow_book
tools.description: Check out an available library copy to a patron.
queries: I'd like to take this copy home.
Lend this edition to the member.

tools.name: hold_book
tools.description: Request the next available copy of a library title.
queries: Put me next in line for that novel.
Every copy is checked out, save one for me when it comes back.

tools.name: renew_loan
tools.description: Extend the due date of a checked-out library book.
queries: I need another week with the book I have.
Can I keep this copy beyond Friday?

tools.name: return_book
tools.description: Check a borrowed library copy back into the collection.
queries: I brought the borrowed atlas back.
Close the loan and put the copy back on the shelf.

tools.name: calculate_area
tools.description: Calculate the surface area enclosed by a flat shape.
queries: How much fabric would cover this round piece?
Find the number of square meters inside the outline.

tools.name: calculate_perimeter
tools.description: Calculate the length around a flat shape.
queries: How much edging goes around the border?
Measure the full distance along the outer edge.

tools.name: calculate_volume
tools.description: Calculate the capacity enclosed by a solid shape.
queries: How many cubic centimeters would fit inside the cylinder?
Find the internal capacity of the box.

tools.name: calculate_surface_area
tools.description: Calculate the sum of exterior face areas of a solid shape.
queries: How much paint covers every face of the cube?
Add up the area of all external faces.
